terms.comment: eho is the interjection of comedy (Plaut.; Ter.).
Lewis & Short: “ho! holloa! ho there!”; to stop someone, or to say enough (see that’s enough!).

phrases.latin: abscēde etiam nunc — etiam nunc — etiam — ohē, istīc astātō.
phrases.english: Back up a bit more — more — more — whoa, stand right there.

sources: Lewis & Short: eho
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 34.
